title: A Recipe for the Detention
author: Juniper Sandoval
blurb: Emrys Fairweather, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before prom.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
